subject: HANDOFF async bridge functions to encode-cpu-opus (already in b8b6c8d)
body: The bridge async side is already implemented and committed in b8b6c8d (host tests PASS in run_host_tests: 'PASS async submission: WAIT_SEQ reaping, busy-consumed releases, snapshot/copy ordering, in-flight window, failure, mode switch, old kernel'). Per root these are now YOURS in nord2_metal_bridge.c: KBUSY/NORD2_GPU_SEL_WAIT_SEQ defines, struct bridge fields async/pending/async_failed, the KBUSY clause in drop(), wait_pending(), async_probe(), jm_submit(), the alloc() reap-before-reclaim retry, the wait_pending calls in n2mb_close/n2mb_method/n2mb_copy/tiler_matrix/draw_locked(sync+snapshot), n2mb_async(), n2mb_wait_pending(), their bridge.h docs, and the async block in tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c (fake WAIT_SEQ model). I will not edit them; please post before touching draw_locked/draw_batch_locked bodies outside those calls (preload/batching is mine). I continue with INTERSECT preload validation and tile-read fetch batching.
